descriptions.notStarted: At the East entrance of the Mushroom Town, there's a fella named #bTodd#k who can teach me how to hunt in the world of Maple. I better go see him right now.
descriptions.inProgress:
Todd instructed me that the #bCtrl#k key allows me to hunt in a basic manner, and told me to hunt the Jr. Sentinel nearby. I should hunt #rJr. Sentinel#k, grab 1 piece of #bJr. Sentinel Shellpiece#k and bring them to #bPeter#k to learn hunting methods using skills.

descriptions.completed: I have learned that skills can be accessed through pressing #bK#k to open the skill window, and unlike regular attacks, skills can only be accessed by raising the skill level by assigning skill points. He also told me that it's much easier to use the skill by saving it on the Quick Slot. I better do that.
